metadata.title: Horner Cscape 10.2 Multi-Rate Dynamic Closed-Loop Scan Audit
metadata.standard: IEC 61131-3 / ISA-18.2 / NAMUR NE 43 / IEC 61511 / IEC 62682
metadata.engine: Horner Cscape 10.2 Native IEC 61131-3 MCP Simulation Engine

scan_rates.name: Scan Rate 1 (High-speed interrupt task)
scan_rates.description: Sub-millisecond high-speed interrupt task for fast servo/injection control

scan_rates.name: Scan Rate 2 (Fast cyclic task)
scan_rates.description: Fast deterministic cyclic task for precision pressure and flow loops

scan_rates.name: Scan Rate 3 (Nominal Cscape scan task)
scan_rates.description: Standard nominal Horner Cscape 10.2 IEC logic scan cycle

scan_rates.name: Scan Rate 4 (Standard I/O update task)
scan_rates.description: Standard analog/digital field bus and remote I/O refresh task

scan_rates.name: Scan Rate 5 (Slow background task)
scan_rates.description: Slow asynchronous background task for thermal regulation and tank storage

scan_rates.name: Scan Rate 6 (Low-rate telemetry task)
scan_rates.description: Low-rate SCADA/telemetry polling and remote supervisory update task
